question: What protective power is sought from the land of Kurukṣetra?
premises: Kurukṣetra is the land of the Kauravas.
The speaker asks it to protect from fear.
inference: The sacred land of Kurukṣetra is invoked for protection from fear.
plain_english: May the land of Kurukṣetra, of the Kauravas, protect me from fear.
